item.title: Piano Battle — Mar 20, 2027
item.description: Lied Center for Performing Arts Saturday, March 20, 2027 · 12:00 AM It’s classical music like you’ve never seen it before! In Piano Battle, virtuoso pianists Andreas Kern and Paul Cibis go head-to-head in a thrilling, interactive competition where the audience decides the winner of each round. Blending dazzling technique with humor and showmanship, this high-energy performance transforms a traditional recital into an unforgettable musical showdown. Who performs it best? You decide! Source: Lied Center for Performing Arts

item.title: Angel Stanislav Wang — Sep 29, 2026
item.description: Lied Center for Performing Arts Tuesday, September 29, 2026 · 12:00 AM Praised for his expressive depth, commanding technique, and artistic individuality, 23-year-old rising virtuoso Angel Stanislav Wang has quickly drawn international attention as a rare and compelling new pianist. His major accolades include winning First Prize at the International Rachmaninoff Piano Competition, becoming the youngest finalist at the 2025 Van Cliburn International Piano Competition, and at just age 23, he has already earned 35 international awards. Source: Lied Center for Performing Arts

item.description: Lied Center for Performing Arts Tuesday, October 20, 2026 · 12:00 AM The World’s MOST Iconic Ballet - With a LIVE Orchestra! Source: Lied Center for Performing Arts

item.title: Orpheus Chamber Orchestra — Feb 17, 2027
item.description: Lied Center for Performing Arts Wednesday, February 17, 2027 · 12:00 AM GRAMMY® award-winning Orpheus Chamber Orchestra returns to the Lied with British virtuoso pianist Isata Kanneh-Mason for an evening of elegance and vitality. The program pairs classical favorites by Mozart and Haydn with selections from Handel’s Water Music Suite and a newly commissioned work by Katie Jenkins, showcasing Orpheus’ trademark conductor-less precision and collaborative spirit. Source: Lied Center for Performing Arts

item.title: CARMEN.maquia Ballet Hispánico — Feb 4, 2027
item.description: Lied Center for Performing Arts Thursday, February 4, 2027 · 12:00 AM Bizet's Carmen has seen countless interpretations over the past 150 years, but never one like this. Acclaimed choreographer Gustavo Ramírez Sansano brings this full-length ballet to the stage, inspired by tauromaquia – the art of bullfighting – breathing a modern life into this legendary character. Highly original and full of explosive movement that leaves you breathless, CARMEN.maquia is a bold reimagining of this tragic tale presented by Ballet Hispánico New York, the... Source: Lied Center for Performing Arts

item.title: Daniil Trifonov — Mar 22, 2027
item.description: Lied Center for Performing Arts Monday, March 22, 2027 · 12:00 AM Praised as “the most astounding pianist of our age” by London’s The Times, GRAMMY® Award-winning pianist Daniil Trifonov makes his Lied Center debut with a program showcasing extraordinary range.
